examples.title: Morning headlines
examples.prompt: Every weekday at 8, give me three headlines worth knowing and one sentence on each.

examples.title: Weekly review
examples.prompt: Every Friday at 4 in the afternoon, ask me three questions that help me review my week.

examples.title: Stretch reminder
examples.prompt: Every day at 3 in the afternoon, give me a two-minute stretch I can do at my desk.

examples.title: One-off nudge
examples.prompt: Tomorrow at 9, remind me to book the dentist and suggest what to say on the call.
